title: Tested property (Test #001, Break Axiom 1)
description: A property carried by a transmission. `status` is derived by the verifier from its own observations and is never accepted from the sender: a record arriving with status 'verified' is treated as having no status.

property.description: What is claimed, as a property of evidence where possible (e.g. 'quote occurs in source at locator'), not of an agent's act (e.g. 'A read the source').

claim.description: What the sender asserts. Moves no status.

verifier.description: Who the status is for. The same property can be verified for one verifier and asserted for another.

evidence.description: Primitive data only. Flags such as 'sourced' or 'checked' are not evidence.

observed_as.description: The authority under which the sender fetched: anonymous, or a named credential.

content_sha256.description: Proposed by this test: a hash of the bytes the sender fetched, so that a verifier's 'same bytes' has a referent. Absent from the 0.5.1 profile.

status.description: Derived. Written only by the verifier's own check, from the distinguishability verdict for this verifier.
